name: io.github.JowenDelaPena/date-math
title: Date Math
description: Date/time math for agents: business days, holidays, time zones, cron, RRULE. 25 free calls/day.

environmentVariables.name: DATE_MATH_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. The most to pay for one call (default $0.001).
